name: github
title: GitHub
description: Editable GitHub timestamp ingestion with complete issue and pull request context and full stargazer scans.

changes: Sync issues through overlapping updated-time windows, advancing the watermark only after complete destination acknowledgement.
Collect all accessible issue comments and pull-request context, reporting provider caps on commits and files.
Group independent repository/resource streams in one configurable pipeline, using paginate and fullSync for stargazers without custom scan state.
Separate editable configuration, injectable HTTP client, and resource readers; cover isolated selection, retries, and failure recovery without changing raw destinations.
Introduce raw repository issues and stargazers ingestion.

resources.name: issues
resources.title: Issues and pull requests
resources.description: Issues and pull requests updated inside a timestamp window, including paginated comments and pull request context.

resources.name: stargazers
resources.title: Stargazers
resources.description: Repository stargazers with starred_at when the token permits it

setup: Provide GITHUB_TOKEN with read access to the selected resources.
Supply a new access token when the existing token expires.

sync.description: One pipeline groups independent issues and stargazers streams for each configured repository. Issues use completed timestamp windows with five-minute overlap; stargazers use fullSync and journaled stream completion.
sync.schedule: Run bunx chkit ingest run --tag provider:github from a scheduler.
sync.deletions: Deleted issues and removed stars remain stored. Periodic historical reconciliation refreshes child context; absence does not generate tombstones.
